entities.summary: NATO membership (2004), EU accession (January 1, 2007), ongoing anti-corruption struggles (DNA), massive diaspora emigration, the Colectiv nightclub fire (2015) sparking anti-corruption protests, and Romania's growing strategic importance in the context of the Ukraine war.
